panels.title: Alertes émises sur la dernière heure

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(alerts), 0) AS alertes FROM ops.alert_metrics WHERE recorded_at > now() - interval '1 hour'

panels.title: Montant à risque, dernier jour chargé
panels.description: Somme des transactions couvertes par une alerte.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount_at_risk_eur), 0) AS montant FROM marts.mart_fraud_daily WHERE event_date = (SELECT max(event_date) FROM marts.mart_fraud_daily)

panels.title: Part des transactions signalées, dernier jour chargé

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * sum(alerted_transactions) / NULLIF(sum(transactions), 0) AS part FROM marts.mart_fraud_daily WHERE event_date = (SELECT max(event_date) FROM marts.mart_fraud_daily)

panels.title: Alertes par minute, par règle (temps réel)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', recorded_at) AS time, rule AS metric, sum(alerts) AS value FROM ops.alert_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT risk_rank AS "rang", merchant_name AS "commerçant", category AS "catégorie", merchant_country AS "pays", alerted_transactions AS "transactions signalées", round(amount_at_risk_eur, 0) AS "montant à risque (€)" FROM marts.mart_merchant_risk ORDER BY risk_rank LIMIT 10

panels.title: Cartes au score combiné le plus élevé
panels.description: Score combiné : somme des scores des alertes d'une carte sur une journée, plafonnée à 100.

targets.rawSql: SELECT '**** ' || card_last4 AS "carte", alert_date AS "journée", rules AS "règles", combined_score AS "score", combined_level AS "niveau" FROM marts.mart_card_risk_daily ORDER BY combined_score DESC, alerts DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Montant à risque par canal, dernier jour chargé

targets.rawSql: SELECT channel AS canal, round(sum(amount_at_risk_eur), 0) AS "montant à risque" FROM marts.mart_fraud_daily WHERE event_date = (SELECT max(event_date) FROM marts.mart_fraud_daily) GROUP BY channel ORDER BY 2 DESC
